name: J.P. Morgan Asset Management — Guide to the Markets
description: J.P. Morgan Asset Management's quarterly slide deck of market and economic charts (valuation, earnings, fixed income, the yield curve, international, alternatives, retirement) distributed as a PDF and updated each quarter. Used here as a design/framing reference, not a data feed: it shows how a widely-used industry chartbook labels and annotates the same kinds of series this site charts (e.g. its P/E-vs-20-year-average panel, its yield-curve snapshot).

notes: The current quarter's PDF/slide deck is reachable from this landing page without login; some interactive tools and the mobile app require a Financial Professional or Shareholder login.
Published quarterly (the page section is titled "Quarterly Economic & Market Update").
